text:
elaine_cs: Velox onboarding - they're getting sporadic 429s after enabling our JS SDK in a serverless warm pool. spike when they scale from 15 -> 140 instances.

elaine_cs: customer log excerpt:
```
2026-06-02T10:03:02Z WARN req=vm1 POST /v1/chat 429 x-rate-limit-remaining=0
2026-06-02T10:03:02Z INFO req=vm2 POST /v1/chat 200 time=95ms
```

elaine_cs: they said their auth flow mints tokens per invocation, ttl=28s, and they use node-fetch without keep-alive.

raphael_se: per-invocation mint + no connection reuse -> auth-validation burst. ask them to: 1) cache token at process level for ttl-5s 2) use an Agent (keep-alive) or our SDK with persistent connections 3) add a randomized init sleep on cold starts.

raphael_se: quick node patch: 
```
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true });
let cache = {t:null, e:0};
async function getToken(){ if(Date.now()<cache.e-5000) return cache.t; const r = await fetch('https://auth.velox.app/get'); const d=await r.json(); cache = {t:d.token, e:Date.now()+d.ttl*1000}; return cache.t }
// fetch(url,{agent, headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${await getToken()}`}})
```

noah_engineer: data point - we repro'd with 120 simulated warmers doing fresh auth + requests; 429s spike within 30s. short-term mitigation: we can open a 15m grace window to convert hard 429 -> 429-with-retry-suggest header for this tenant while they patch.

sam_support: creating canary plan: 1) deploy token-cache + agent to 10% traffic 2) monitor 429 rate and x-rate-limit-* metrics for 20m 3) ramp to 100% if stable. can ops open mitigation?

mitigation_bot: mitigation ticket #CS-6777 created. owner=noah_engineer expires_in=15m playbook=token-cache-grace

elaine_cs: Velox tested cache+agent in staging: 429s dropped from 7.8% -> 0.5% in 8m. starting 10% prod canary now.

raphael_se: long-term: we'll add a KB entry on "ephemeral-token per invocation" anti-pattern and include node/python code samples and SDK config guidance (keepAlive=true, tokenCache=true, prefetch=1 for serverless).

elaine_cs: capture note for renewal: resolved during onboarding, customer more confident about scale. I'll close if no regressions after 24h.
